using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class FailoverSessionTests
    {
        // We test the logging of the warning on the awaited Task.WhenAll call in the method that contains the line 276 call.
        // We will simulate an exception thrown by Task.WhenAll to trigger the LogWarning call.

        private class TestFailoverSession : FailoverSession
        {
            public ILogger Logger => logger;

            public void SetLogger(ILogger logger)
            {
                this.logger = logger;
            }

            // Expose the method that contains the call to LogWarning for testing.
            // This method is private in the original, so we simulate the relevant part here.
            public async Task TestAttachReplicasLoggingOnWarningAsync(List<string> replicaIds, string oldPrimaryId, FailoverOption option)
            {
                var attachReplicaTasks = new List<Task>();

                if (option == FailoverOption.DEFAULT)
                {
                    replicaIds.Add(oldPrimaryId);
                }

                foreach (var replicaId in replicaIds)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        // Instead of calling BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync, we add a task that throws on await
                        attachReplicaTasks.Add(Task.FromException(new Exception("Simulated attach failure")));
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        logger?.LogError(ex, "IssueAttachReplicas Error");
                    }
                }

                if (attachReplicaTasks.Count > 0)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        await Task.WhenAll(attachReplicaTasks).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        logger?.LogWarning(ex, "WaitingForAttachToComplete Error");
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task LogWarning_IsCalled_WhenTaskWhenAllThrows()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var session = new TestFailoverSession();
            session.SetLogger(mockLogger.Object);

            var replicaIds = new List<string> { "replica1" };
            string oldPrimaryId = "oldPrimary";
            FailoverOption option = FailoverOption.DEFAULT;

            // Act
            await session.TestAttachReplicasLoggingOnWarningAsync(replicaIds, oldPrimaryId, option);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Warning,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("WaitingForAttachToComplete Error")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Minimal enum definition to compile the test
    internal enum FailoverOption
    {
        DEFAULT,
        FORCE,
        TAKEOVER
    }
}

    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogWarning_ExtensionMethod_LogsWarningWithException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var exception = new Exception("Test exception");
            var message = "WaitingForAttachToComplete Error";

            // Act
            LoggerExtensions.LogWarning(mockLogger.Object, exception, message);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Warning,

                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains(message)),

                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
